seoTitle: Blue Valley Schools Calendar 2027–28: Key Dates
seoDescription: Blue Valley grades 6 and 9 attend Transition Day Aug. 11, 2027; the EC–12 first day is Aug. 12. See breaks, grade-specific days off, early releases and year-end dates.
heroSummary: Blue Valley students in grades 6 and 9 attend Transition Day on Wednesday, August 11, 2027. The first day for EC–12 is August 12, which is also kindergarten orientation day. Thanksgiving Break runs November 22–26, Winter Break December 20–31, and Spring Break March 13–17. Seniors' last day is May 12. Early Childhood finishes May 23, and grades K–11 finish May 24 with early release.
heroSourceLine: Based on the official Blue Valley 2027–28 calendar, board approved April 13, 2026
verificationBadgeText: Checked against current Blue Valley sources

heroVerificationComparisonText: The board notice was used to confirm the separate Early Childhood and K–11 year-end dates
calendarNotes: August 11 is a transition day only for grades 6 and 9; the EC–12 first day and kindergarten orientation are August 12. The K–5 professional-collaboration closures do not apply to grades 6–12. During conference weeks, October 21 and February 17 are no-school days for EC–8 while grades 9–12 attend; October 22 and February 18 are no-school days for EC–12. High-school finals use building schedules. The annual calendar labels May 13–14 as tentative graduation dates. Blue Valley's approval notice identifies May 23 as the Early Childhood last day and May 24 as the K–11 last day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Blue Valley's 2028 graduation dates final?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Blue Valley lists May 13–14 as tentative graduation dates. Families should check with their high school for the confirmed ceremony date, time and location.

customSections.label: How the Blue Valley 2027–28 Opening Works
customSections.content: Only students in grades 6 and 9 attend on August 11 for Transition Day. If your child is not in grade 6 or 9, use August 12 as the district's published first day; that date also includes kindergarten orientation.

table.caption: Blue Valley 2027–28 opening schedule
rows: First day of school; kindergarten orientation
table.footnote: Schools provide kindergarten orientation times and transition-day details.

customSections.label: Not Every Blue Valley No-School Day Applies to Every Grade
customSections.content: Blue Valley has several no-school days that apply only to certain grade levels. K–5 collaboration days do not affect middle or high school students, while EC–8 conference closures still have grades 9–12 in class.

table.caption: Student attendance rules in the Blue Valley 2027–28 calendar
rows: No School K–5 — Teacher Professional Collaboration

customSections.label: Blue Valley School Hours and Early Release Times
customSections.content: Blue Valley publishes a different early-release time for each school level. Its high schools follow an odd/even block schedule, and Blue Valley North begins five minutes earlier than the other high schools on Tuesday and Thursday.

table.caption: Blue Valley published school and early-release hours
rows: Mon./Wed. 7:35 a.m.; Tue./Thu. 8:35 a.m.; Fri. 7:35 a.m. — all end 2:45 p.m.
Mon./Wed. 7:35 a.m.; Tue./Thu. 8:30 a.m.; Fri. 7:35 a.m. — all end 2:45 p.m.
table.footnote: Families in CAPS, Blue Valley Academy or Early Childhood should check their program's calendar for hours and dismissal details.

customSections.label: Early Childhood, Seniors and Grades K–11 Finish Separately
customSections.content: Blue Valley's final student dates differ by grade level. Seniors finish May 12, tentative graduation dates are May 13–14, Early Childhood finishes May 23, and grades K–11 finish May 24 with early release. Grades 9–11 also have early-release finals May 22–23.

customSections.content: Use the annual district PDF and Blue Valley's board approval notice for the 2027–28 school-year dates. Use the live district or school calendar for building events, conference times and changes published later.
